git.description: Run arbitrary git commands (read-only inspection: status, diff, log, show ...)

gradleUnstick.description: Diagnose Gradle 'Timeout waiting to lock ...' states (safe to run any time): stops container-local daemons, then classifies every Gradle lock file by real flock contention, visible holders and recorded owner PID. Ends with VERDICT: RETRY-OK (nothing flocked, just retry) | BUSY (visible holder, listed) | INVISIBLE-HOLDER (flocked but no visible process = host GUH build -> escalate to the user, never delete); exit 2 = action required

gradleUnstickWipe.description: Delete Gradle lock records (*.lock/*.lck) ONLY when each is flock-proven uncontended and no Gradle process is visible (VERDICT: WIPED); refuses otherwise (VERDICT: REFUSED). For the stale-record case where Gradle times out although nothing holds the lock. Lock records are recreated on demand; nothing else in caches/wrapper/jdks is ever touched - those are shared with the host GUH, so escalate instead of deleting anything beyond lock records

test_scripts.description: Run the shell test suite (tests/bash) pinning the docker launcher composition

compile_test.description: Compile test sources (fastest loop for test-code errors)
